problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of C² functions, permitting nonconvexity, with globally L-Lipschitz gradient, ρ-Lipschitz Hessian in operator norm, and f(x₀)−inf f≤Δ. Parameters satisfy L>0, ρ>0, Δ≥0, ε>0.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact Boolean pairwise comparison oracle: a query (x,y) returns whether f(x)≤f(y), including the specified tie convention. No function values or derivatives are supplied; answers are independent of history and seeds.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space; the budget depends explicitly on dim E.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ComparisonHessianLipschitz.lean: Params.normedE, Params.innerE, Params.finiteE; supplied extracted budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters E, x₀, L, ρ, Δ, ε are public; f is hidden. Global Hessian Lipschitz continuity supplements gradient Lipschitz continuity. Output points must be x₀ or endpoints of executed comparison queries.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ComparisonHessianLipschitz.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Instance, spec.admissible, spec.allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The output is a finite list containing at least one x with ‖∇f(x)‖≤ε; identification of that member is not required.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Success holds for every algorithm and oracle seed, rather than merely almost surely or with high probability. The extracted budget caps all comparison calls.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Uses comparison-only information and requires a queried-point list containing a stationary point for every seed under a fixed oracle budget.
